EmailTemplate.subject: Intel Partner Alliance: Business License Needed
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for applying to the Intel® Partner Alliance!
Thank you for applying to the Intel Partner Alliance.
While processing your application, we were unable to verify your company information based on the input you provided. Therefore, we kindly request you reply to this email by attaching one of the following documents in either PDF, JPEG, or PNG format to complete this verification:
Business Certificate (indicating your company address matches the application) Tax Certificate (indicating your company address matches the application) Company Website (displaying your company address matches the application)
Please reply to this email with the attached document(s) within 4 days to avoid automatic rejection of your request. Once we have received your response, we will advise the team to re-review your application.
Thank you for your cooperation in resolving this matter.
Thank you, Your Intel® Partner Alliance team
Please know that this email inbox is automatically processed and monitored.
